priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility to the Finance Committee for overseeing financing transactions. Everson's resignation was submitted in a letter, which is attached to the filing as an exhibit, and he did not serve on any committee of the Board at the time of his resignation. priority.summary: Toby R. Neugebauer, the co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc., has issued a statement in response to the company's decision to drop its lawsuit against him, which was filed to validate a 70% supermajority bylaw amendment. The lawsuit's dismissal comes after a Texas Business Court ordered Fermi to produce documents and testimony explaining the rationale for the bylaw amendment, and Neugebauer claims that the company's actions confirm that the bylaw move was about entrenching the board's power rather than good governance. Neugebauer's claims challenging the validity of the bylaw remain alive and he will continue to pursue discovery and depositions of key players.
